title: "Detect from Project" feature in "Engine Compilation Configuration Profile" doesn't work
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:
Godot 4.5dev3 to 4.5beta4

Works perfectly, and not reproducible in:
Godot 4.4.1 Stable

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev3.mono - Debian GNU/Linux 13 (trixie) 13 w/Xanmod Kernel, on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6600 (RADV NAVI23) - AMD FX(tm)-8350 Eight-Core Processor (8 threads) 32GB RAM

### Issue description


The build trimming feature "Engine Compilation Configuration Profile" located at:
Project > Tools > Engine Compilation Configuration Profile

Does not work correctly, or at all on Godot 4.5dev3 to 4.5beta4 releases.

-Beta4
Edit Compilation Configuration Profile window:
After pressing "Detect from Project" > Scanning process gets stuck at 33%.

Scanning cannot be Cancelled by pressing the Cancel button;
nor the Close button on the "Edit Compilation Configuration Profile" window itself.

Godot Editor UI is out of focus so to speak, so it's deactivated,
so I cannot open the Godot Editor Menus or close the program in any way.

To Close Godot I need to Kill/terminate the process externally.

(I also get this unrelated error hundreds of times on launch
ERROR: drivers/accesskit/accessibility_driver_accesskit.cpp:352 - Condition "index < 0 || index >= t.length()" is true. Continuing.)

-Dev3:
Edit Compilation Configuration Profile window:
After pressing "Detect from Project" > I cannot see any trace of the Scanning process, no message window appears.

Then similarly:
The process cannot be Stopped/Closed by pressing the Close button on the "Edit Compilation Configuration Profile" window.

Godot Editor UI is out of focus so to speak, so it's deactivated,
so I cannot open the Godot Editor Menus or Close the program in any way.

To close Godot I need to Kill/terminate the process externally.


-4.4.1 Stable
Edit Compilation Configuration Profile window: Works Perfectly!

After pressing "Detect from Project" > Scanning process is almost immediate and Completes 100%.

The list of elements in the "Configure Engine Compilation Profile" is updated correctly,
and the unused elements are Disabled.

-I guess this will Exclude and not include those elements on Build/export, 
and potentially reduce the app size, or remove unnecessary elements/complexity?


### Steps to reproduce

Go to :
Project > Tools > Engine Compilation Configuration Profile

Click on "Detect from Project", 
see the Scanning process fail..

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Just try it in your projects;
The two very different/unrelated apps I'm working on show the same behavior.
